name: django-brickwork-frontend
description: Frontend build for the brickwork Django package. Compiles design tokens (Style Dictionary, from src/brickwork/tokens/source) and component CSS/JS (Vite + @tailwindcss/vite) into src/brickwork/static/brickwork/dist as STABLE, non-hashed filenames versioned by the Python package's own semver. Consumers reference these via plain {% static %}; django-vite is deliberately not required (build-tool research 2026-07-30).

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:assets
